title: Laumufarþegi deployment diagram
description: How Laumufarþegi runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and a Durable Object namespace, Room, with one SQLite-backed object per room code. Every player's browser holds a WebSocket to their room's object, which keeps the room's state and decides the game. No database and no secrets; the login service is asked only when someone starts a room.

nodes.name: Host's browser
nodes.description: The page, on the device of whoever starts the room; signed in to icelander.net with the role games:laumufarthegi.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: The page, opened from the room's link on a player's own phone or computer; no sign-in. Keeps the seat's token in localStorage.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on the route icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi*, ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*, and serves the static assets.

nodes.name: laumufarthegi Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the page (uncached HTML), api/me, api/rooms and the room's WebSocket upgrade; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: Room Durable Object
nodes.description: One object per room code (ROOMS.idFromName): takes the room's hibernatable WebSockets, applies actions one at a time and runs its alarm for timeouts and the idle clean-up.

nodes.name: Room storage
nodes.description: Each object's own SQLite-backed storage (the rooms-v1 migration's new_sqlite_classes), holding the room's whole state under one key until the room is deleted.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository: who holds the site_session cookie and their games: roles. Reached only through a service binding.
nodes.condition: api/me and api/rooms, unless HOST_SIGN_IN is none

artifacts.name: app.js
artifacts.description: esbuild bundle of web/app.ts with the shared types, minified, served as a static asset and run in the browser.

artifacts.name: index.html, style.css, favicon.svg and _headers
artifacts.description: Copied into dist/games/laumufarthegi/ (and _headers to dist/): a Content-Security-Policy that allows only this origin and wss://icelander.net.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler with the shared rules and the topic grids.

artifacts.name: Room class
artifacts.description: Exported from the same Worker script and bound as ROOMS.

relationships.description: Routes icelander.net/games/laumufarthegi* to the Worker; the Worker runs first only for the page and api/*.
HTTPS: the page, GET api/me, POST api/rooms; then a WebSocket to the room like every player.
HTTPS for the page; WebSocket (wss) GET api/rooms/CODE/ws, kept open with a ping every 25 s.
Durable Object binding ROOMS: POST /create, and /ws with the browser's upgrade passed through.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal), only to decide who may start a room.
